verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a per-endpoint API reference (convert-document, extract-structured-data, segment-document, and others), but nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Forge is a document-upload playground, an adjacent feature rather than an interactive API reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no spec-driven explorer is evidenced either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
